svg.aria-label: Three-stage integrated forecasting framework: Stage I curtailment risk; Stage II available-power prediction; Stage III actual-power correction and feedback selection.
svg.desc: Historical performance uses target observations available at prediction time within the preceding 14 days, matched by wind farm, predicted risk state, and residual-model version. For each candidate, daily error reduction is averaged over days with at least eight records. Eligibility requires at least three such days and 32 records in total. The score subtracts 1.64 times the standard error of the mean daily gain from the mean daily gain. The eligible candidate with the highest score is adopted only when its score exceeds the prescribed positive threshold. Otherwise, the baseline forecast is retained. Solid arrows show current forecast computations. Dashed arrows show forecast storage and updates following newly available observations.

g.title: The direct CatBoost forecast is adjusted by a local ridge regression when historical feedback supports it.

g.text: Paired errors of B and P̃(j)

g.title: For each candidate, subtract the uncertainty penalty from its mean daily error reduction. Positions illustrate the calculation.
